settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.trivy_url_tooltip: The URL of the Trivy server to use for vulnerability scanning. it must be set inside the Dependency-Track user interface.
settings.trivy_token_tooltip: The Trivy token to use for vulnerability scanning. it must be set inside the Dependency-Track user interface.
settings.migration_notice_title: Dependency-Track has been migrated to version 5
settings.migration_notice_intro: Version 5 cannot decrypt the secrets stored by version 4, so they were cleared.
settings.migration_notice_trivy_enabled: The module reconfigured the Trivy analyzer with the settings it had in version 4.
settings.migration_notice_trivy_prepared: Trivy stays off as it was in version 4, but its URL and token are stored, so enabling it is now a single switch.
settings.migration_notice_trivy_none: The Trivy analyzer has to be set up by hand.
settings.migration_notice_todo: Still to do by hand: re-enter repository passwords and integration keys, and re-enable the notification rules.
settings.migration_notice_todo_analyzers: Still to do by hand: enter the API token of {analyzers} — everything else about them is already set — re-enter repository passwords and integration keys, and re-enable the notification rules.
